Meet Mr Sir. Listen for...

01

1. What does Mr Sir eat, and why?

02

2. What are the rules for digging a hole?

03

3. Why is there no fence around the camp?

Pause at: "Mr. Sir" · "This isn't a Girl Scout camp" · "the only water for a hundred miles"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: chapter 4
A1Why does Mr Sir eat sunflower seeds?
Mr Sir eats sunflower seeds because he ...
What did he stop doing last month?
Mr Sir eats sunflower seeds because he quit smoking last month. He used to smoke a pack a day; now he eats a sack of seeds every week.
A2What are the rules for digging?
Each boy digs ___ hole every day. It must be ___ deep and ___ across. The ___ is the measuring stick.
Each boy digs one hole every day, even on Saturdays and Sundays. It must be five feet deep and five feet across. The shovel is the measuring stick.
A3Why doesn't Camp Green Lake need a fence?
There is no fence because ...
What does the camp have that nowhere else nearby has?
There is no fence because the camp has the only water for a hundred miles. Anyone who runs away will die of thirst: "buzzard food in three days."
A4What does Mr Sir say his gun is for? What does he say next?
His gun is for ___. Then he says "___", which shows he is ___.
It is not for the boys. Find the word "bullet".
His gun is for yellow-spotted lizards. Then he says "I wouldn't waste a bullet on you", which shows he is cruel and wants to scare Stanley.
Extension (early finishers): Mr Sir asks Stanley if he wants to run away. Why do you think he asks this?
WATCHno writing yetHow do we know what a character is like?

Look at what they SAY, DO and LOOK like

Coach Barker marched onto the frozen pitch in shorts, blowing his whistle so hard that the birds flew away. "Ten more laps!" he barked. "Nobody goes inside until I say so." When a boy slipped in the mud, Coach Barker didn't help him up. He just looked at his stopwatch.

SAYS"Ten more laps!"→ strict, bossy
DOESdoesn't help the boy who falls→ unkind
LOOKSshorts in the cold, a whistle→ tough

Character File: Detail 1: He is strict: he shouts "Ten more laps!"  ·  Detail 2: He is unkind: he doesn't help a boy who falls.  ·  Signature: his whistle.

A good detail = what he is like + how we know.
SAY ITTHEN WRITECharacter File: Mr Sir

STEP 1: SAY IT What does each one show?

He makes Stanley call him "Mr Sir".STRICT
He drinks soda in front of thirsty Stanley and gives him none.CRUEL
"I wouldn't waste a bullet on you."CRUEL
"You're going to be thirsty for the next eighteen months."CRUEL
He eats a sack of sunflower seeds every week.SIGNATURE
"This isn't a Girl Scout camp."SIGNATURE

Choose from: strict · cruel · signature (a habit or catchphrase that is "so him")

STEP 2: WRITE at the back of your notebook

Mr Sir

Detail 1: He is ___: he ___ (ch 4)

Detail 2: He is ___: he ___ (ch 4)

Signature: ___

Detail 1: He is strict: he makes Stanley call him "Mr Sir" (ch 4).
Detail 2: He is cruel: he tells Stanley he will be "thirsty for the next eighteen months" (ch 4).
Signature: he eats sunflower seeds because he quit smoking.
Try to choose different evidence from the model. Looks: cowboy hat, sunglasses, rattlesnake tattoo also count.

Meet Mr Pendanski and Group D. Listen for...

01

1. What is the one rule at Camp Green Lake?

02

2. What do the boys call Mr Pendanski?

03

3. What does Mr Pendanski say about Zero?

Pause at: "pen, dance, key" · "Don't upset the Warden" · "nothing inside his head" · "Armpit"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 5 · part 1
B1According to Mr Pendanski, what is the only rule at Camp Green Lake?
Mr Pendanski says the only rule is "___".
Mr Pendanski says the only rule is "Don't upset the Warden."
B2Why does Mr Pendanski call the boys by their real names?
He uses their real names because they are the names ...
Who gave the boys these names? Who will use them when the boys leave?
He uses their real names because they are the names their parents gave them: the names society will use when they leave and become "useful and hardworking" people.
B3What do the boys call Mr Pendanski? Why is this funny?
The boys call him ___. This is funny because ...
Look at how he is described: his head, his face.
The boys call him "Mom". This is funny because he is a man with a thick black beard, but he tries to act caring, like a mother.
B1 matters: it is a real test-style question.
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 5 · part 2
B4What does Mr Pendanski say about Zero? What does this show about him?
He says Zero's name is Zero because "___". This shows that he ...
Find "You know why his name's Zero?"
He says it is because "there's nothing inside his head." This shows that he can be cruel and makes fun of Zero, even though he seems kind.
B5Why does Armpit throw Stanley to the ground?
Armpit throws Stanley to the ground because Stanley ...
Armpit throws Stanley to the ground because Stanley calls him by his real name, Theodore, instead of his nickname, Armpit.
B6Stretch: who is nicer, Mr Sir or Mr Pendanski? Back it up.
___ seems nicer because ... However, ...
Use one quotation for "seems nice" and one for "however". Look at B4.
Mr Pendanski seems nicer because he says "I respect you" and uses the boys' real names. However, he makes fun of Zero, saying there is "nothing inside his head", so he is not as kind as he seems.
Back It Up page: copy the B6 frame "___ seems ... However, ..." into your Back It Up section.
SAY ITTHEN WRITECharacter File: Mr Pendanski

STEP 1: SAY IT Kind, or not kind?

He tells Stanley, "I respect you."SEEMS KIND
He calls the boys by their real first names.SEEMS KIND
He says Zero has "nothing inside his head".NOT KIND
He says, "I'm going to help you turn your life around."SEEMS KIND
He decides Stanley "made some bad mistakes" without asking.NOT KIND
He tells the boys to shake hands "like gentlemen".SEEMS KIND

STEP 2: WRITE at the back of your notebook

Mr Pendanski

Detail 1: He seems ___: he ___ (ch 5)

Detail 2: However, he is ___: he ___ (ch 5)

Signature: ___

Detail 1: He seems kind: he tells Stanley "I respect you" and uses the boys' real names (ch 5).
Detail 2: However, he is cruel to Zero: he says there is "nothing inside his head" (ch 5).
Signature: the boys call him "Mom".
Always include Detail 2: the "not kind" side matters most for Mr Pendanski.
